description: A four-storey office has a 900 m2 building area. The common exit stair discharges through a hinged exterior door that we want to swing inward, against the direction people leave. This is the common building exit, not a door for a dwelling or storage unit. We would add a larger landing and clear signs.
known_facts: vertical-axis hinged door swings against exit travel
